_about: F. A. Paley (1815-1888), Cambridge classical scholar and Classical Examiner in the University of London: English commentaries and verse renderings, raw IA. Euripides with an English Commentary (Bibliotheca Classica, ed. George Long and A. J. Macleane; London: Whittaker; George Bell), vol. II (1858) and vol. III (1860); vol. I was not found on IA in a readable scan. The Phoenissae of Euripides with brief notes (Cambridge: Deighton, Bell, 1870); The Iphigenia in Tauris with brief notes (George Bell, 1904, posthumous reissue); Fragments of the Greek Comic Poets, with renderings in English verse (Swan Sonnenschein, 1889). Greek text with English commentary, kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. His Pindar (1868) is on the pindar shelf, his Philebus (1879) on the plato shelf, his prose Aeschylus (1864) on the aeschylus shelf. Not taken: The Epics of Hesiod, 2nd ed. 1883 (epicshesiod00hesigoog: only 91k characters of text for a full commentary, a partial OCR). Classical scholarship (lane B, round dt). No uids minted.
